title: America's Gold Is on the Books at $42.22 an Ounce #shorts
description:
The US government owns about 261 million troy ounces of gold (about 147 million at Fort Knox). On the books it's valued at the statutory $42.2222 an ounce, about $11 billion. At the November 6, 2026 gold futures close ($4,074.90), it's worth about $1.07 trillion.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: U.S. Treasury, Status Report of U.S. Government Gold Reserve (Oct 31, 2026); Yahoo Finance GC=F.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
